Messages.Author: Vincent Crisafulli
Messages.Body:
If Andrew Stuart plays Mirror Walk, do I:
A) Reveal the top card of my library, then put it back on the top of my
library since I can't draw up yet.
or
B) Reveal no card, since I'm not drawing to replace the Mirror Walk right
now.

My guess is A.
And yes, I am very much a dummy for playing Andrew Stuart in deck with THA
in the first place.

Andrew Stuart, 5, AUS DOM THA, Tremere, 4, [KoT]
Camarilla: When Andrew plays a card that required Thaumaturgy, reveal the
top card of your library (before drawing to replace). If it also required
Thaumaturgy, the card is canceled and Andrew burns 1 blood.

Mirror Walk, Action Modifier, Thaumaturgy, C , [Third]
Do not replace until your discard phase.
[tha] +1 stealth.
[THA] As [tha] above, and if this action is blocked, the action ends (with
no combat).

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Vincent Crisafulli wrote:
> If Andrew Stuart plays Mirror Walk, do I:
> A) Reveal the top card of my library, then put it back on the top of my
> library since I can't draw up yet.
> or
> B) Reveal no card, since I'm not drawing to replace the Mirror Walk right
> now.
>
> My guess is A.

Correct. Well, there's no "put it back", really, since "reveal" doesn't involve
moving it from the library -- you just reveal it there.

That's what you do for any Thaumaturgy card Andrew plays. Then, typically, the
next thing you do is draw that card you just revealed to replace the THA card
you played.
